mechanism: Captopril reduces renal perfusion pressure through ACE inhibition, which may decrease mycophenolate glucuronide reabsorption and increase mycophenolate mofetil (MMF) active metabolite (MPA) levels, elevating immunosuppression and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor mycophenolate levels and adjust dose if necessary; ensure adequate renal function monitoring and consider alternative antihypertensive if MPA levels become supratherapeutic.
